title: Brothers and cousins reuniting in Mamie Smith's show and Gene Coy's band
summary: All the brothers were on the Mamie Smith show and the cousins went to Gene Coy's Black Aces; Eddie later joined in Oklahoma.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, listen, all the brothers were on the Mamie Smith show.
You and the other three brothers.
What about the cousins. They had left home.

Allen went with Gene Coy's Black Aces -- wait a minute, Clyde went with Gene Coy's Black Aces and then Allen went, you know, Oklahoma City and Battles went. Then when the Mamie Smith show closed, I went to Oklahoma with Battle and got with Gene Coy's Black Aces too.
When we left there, formed another band, and we were all getting back together again. Sometime
But you had that nucleus and you'd join each other.
